description: Creates a new contributing condition for the specified company. The request is idempotent; repeated calls with the same name return the existing record.

id.description: Unique identifier of the contributing condition.

name.description: Translated display name of the contributing condition.

name_key.description: Untranslated name of the contributing condition, matching the original value stored in the database.

active.description: Whether this contributing condition is available for selection on incident records. When false, existing references are preserved but new assignments are prevented.

global.description: Whether this contributing condition is a Procore-provided default. Global contributing conditions cannot be deleted and their names cannot be changed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this contributing condition was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this contributing condition was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

name.description: Display name for the contributing condition. Must be unique within the company. Names of Procore-provided contributing conditions cannot be changed.

active.description: Flag that denotes if the Contributing Condition is available for use
